EEGCoordinateSystemDescription: Participant-specific digitized EEG electrode positions exported from Brainsight. Coordinates are provided in the Brainsight Subject Tracker coordinate frame used at export and are reported in millimetres. These coordinates are not labelled as MNI, template, NIfTI scanner, or individual anatomical MRI coordinates in the exported electrode files.

FiducialsDescription: Nasion, left ear/LPA, and right ear/RPA landmarks were digitized with the same Brainsight system and are represented in the same coordinate frame as the EEG electrode positions.
